verdicts.reason: A breaks up the text block. The 'WEEKEND ONLY' eyebrow sits alone at the top-left, the '20% off' headline drops to the bottom-left, and the body copy floats beside it on a different baseline. Nothing shares an edge, so the reading order runs eyebrow, then body, then headline. B keeps headline, body and eyebrow together in one left-aligned block between the bottle and the CTA, which reads well left to right. Its flaws: the eyebrow has been moved below the body copy, which reverses the original order; the bottle nearly touches the top and bottom edges; and the CTA sits off-centre on the peach circle.
